capabilities: Sync vault files to a remote repository
Detect local and remote changes with a three-way comparison
Resolve conflicts by modification time or manually
Show diffs and a Git-style source-control panel
Store access tokens in the Obsidian keychain
disambiguation: Not limited to Gitee; it also syncs to GitHub, GitLab and Gitea repositories.
extras: On Obsidian versions before 1.11.4 the token falls back to plaintext in data.json; a dedicated private repository is recommended. Installable via BRAT or by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of the community Gitee Sync plugin with a rewritten sync engine
motivation: Forked from the community Gitee Sync plugin to rewrite the sync engine, unify all filtering under .gitignore, and support more platforms without a local Git install.
problem: Keeping a vault in a remote Git repository normally requires Git installed locally plus manual commits and pushes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of the community Gitee Sync plugin with a rewritten sync engine

requires.name: Gitee, GitHub, GitLab or Gitea account
Personal access token with repository read/write scope

summary: Syncs vault notes to a Gitee, GitHub, GitLab or Gitea repository through REST APIs, with three-way change detection and conflict resolution.
